name: Canister filter
definition: an external filter in a closed canister fed by hoses.

name: Hang-on-back filter
definition: a filter hung on the rear of the tank.

name: Internal filter
definition: a filter placed inside the tank.

name: Sump
definition: a separate tank below the aquarium that holds filtration.

name: Under-gravel filter
definition: a filter plate laid under the gravel.

name: Aquarium heater
definition: a heater that warms aquarium water.

name: Aquarium light
definition: a lamp or light unit made for an aquarium.

name: Aquarium substrate
definition: gravel, sand or other bed material for the tank floor.

name: Aquarium decoration
definition: ornaments, rock, wood and other furnishings for a tank.

name: Water test kit
definition: a kit that tests aquarium water.

name: Reptile food
definition: prepared food made for reptiles and amphibians.

name: Frozen feeder animal
definition: a dead frozen animal sold as food for reptiles; live feeders are out.

name: Vivarium or terrarium
definition: an empty enclosure in which reptiles or amphibians are kept.

name: Basking lamp
definition: a lamp that gives a reptile a heated basking spot.

name: Ceramic heat emitter
definition: a heat source that gives heat without light.

name: Deep heat projector
definition: a heat source that projects infrared heat.

name: Heat mat
definition: a heating pad fitted on or against the enclosure.

name: Reptile thermostat
definition: a control that regulates enclosure heat.

name: UVB lamp
definition: a lamp that gives ultraviolet B light to a reptile.

name: Reptile substrate
definition: floor material for a reptile enclosure.

name: Reptile hide
definition: a shelter in which a reptile hides.

name: Wild bird seed
definition: seed or seed mix made for wild birds.

name: Suet or fat ball
definition: a fat-based wild bird food.

name: Tube feeder
definition: a hanging seed tube with ports.

name: Hopper feeder
definition: a seed feeder with a hopper and a tray.

name: Suet feeder
definition: a feeder that holds suet blocks or cakes.

name: Nyjer feeder
definition: a feeder made for fine nyjer seed.

name: Peanut mesh feeder
definition: a steel-mesh feeder for peanuts.

name: Ground feeder
definition: a feeder or tray set at ground level.

name: Bird feeding station
definition: a stand or table carrying several feeders.

name: Nest box
definition: a box made for wild birds to nest in.

name: Bird bath
definition: a basin that gives wild birds water to drink and bathe in.

name: Bee feeder
definition: a device that gives bees syrup or other feed.

name: Framed vertical hive
definition: a hive that grows upward with frames in stacked boxes.

name: Long hive
definition: a horizontal frame hive.
